subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are marked as P, Q, R, S, T, U. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one showing 'Q'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49832dd70a0cae5f4774f1ea8a3167e80be9f7e3335f4231c4beaf4f19c88e8e.png]
solution:
From the given dice,

P and T is the common surface in the both dice,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2eccc5bd919161e4039dd87a7c10ff1b57e328f6194b55fa7083cc5bae67b6bd.png] 

So, the remaining surface 'S' will be the opposite surface of 'Q'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
